audit.validation_scope: Structural/date/label checks only; primary evidence truth and retrieval recall require agent review.

remaining_limits: Search indexes and public release pages may lag; field-wide completeness is not established.
No same-day submission or revision was verified as of the morning of November 23 in Chicago; this partial-day search cannot establish full-day absence.
All selected candidate histories predate November 23. Announcement-page dates were not used as submission dates.

Hugging Face November 23 date URL was inaccessible; its root Daily Papers page showed November 23 and served as a partial fallback. OpenReview search was inaccessible; the CVPR 2026 index returned 403.
Inspected all ten cs.GR new/cross/replacement titles, but only selected matches among 271 cs.CV and 351 cs.AI entries. Rotated cs.HC, cs.MM and eess.IV; cs.RO was not opened.
EvoDesign and PhysAg3D were rechecked beyond the normal seven-day catch-up window to resolve prior pending leads. EvoDesign first-submission anomaly remains pending.
Revision content differences and empirical result reproduction were not assessed.
Ten search batches and 24 attempted primary opens are count caps; retrieval stops when those caps are reached. Actual elapsed time is reported, not padded to six minutes.
Queries and page reads are grouped by tool invocation in the ledger; a source-family association does not imply every result in that batch came from that family.
Search snippets and historical daily claims are leads only. Full-paper reproduction, exhaustive listing scans, citation chaining, and independent experimental validation were not performed.
The tools field remains provisional; the bundled memory definition is internally inconsistent. Unclear cells mean insufficient inspected evidence, not an inferred negative.
publication: Reviewed local CLI skill run, synchronized to GitHub and the website by the authorized publishing workflow.
